description.value: The North Bend Community Centre is a volunteer-run community hub situated across the Fraser River from Boston Bar, housing a local history museum with records dating back to the 1800s, a thrift store, and a drop-in room with free computer internet access. The museum holds an extensive collection of historical photos, census records, and community memorabilia documenting the area's railway heritage and settlement history. Cyclists touring the Fraser Canyon can stop in to explore the deep local heritage of this small riverside community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and confirms the OSM address (64901 North Bend Station Road). The site describes a drop-in room with three computers offering free internet access, a thrift store, a local history museum, and a community garden — but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water access, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities. A name spelling discrepancy exists: OSM uses 'Centre' while the website consistently uses 'Center'.
concerns: Name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'Centre' (Canadian) while the website consistently uses 'Center' (American) — e.g. URL path '/north-bend-community-center.html' and page title 'North Bend Community Center'.
No phone number in OSM or on the website; contact is via email only (Steve Clark for museum inquiries).
Very limited operating hours (Tuesdays and Saturdays only) may make this an unreliable stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The community centre and museum could offer genuine cultural interest to cyclists on the Fraser Canyon route, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are confirmed. The very limited operating hours further reduce its utility as a reliable cyclist service point; a human reviewer should assess whether the museum attraction alone justifies a listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The drop-in room upstairs has three computers with free internet access, which could be useful to cyclists needing connectivity, but this is desktop computer access rather than Wi-Fi.

wow_evidence: Volunteer hub with museum, thrift store, and free drop-in internet — real public services.
blurb: Volunteer community centre with museum, thrift store, and internet.
